name: 7 Bridge
description: Seven Bridge (7 Bridge) is a Japanese Rummy game. 2-5 players. 52-card deck. 7 cards each. Special rule: 7s need only 2-card melds (e.g., 7-7 or 6-7 is valid). Single 7 can be played as 1-card meld. Draw from stock (discard pile restricted). Lay off on any meld. Go out by melding all but last card + discard. All-at-once meld = double score.

content.text: Seven Bridge (7 Bridge) is a Japanese Rummy game. 2-5 players. 52-card deck. 7 cards each. Special rule: 7s need only 2-card melds (e.g., 7-7 or 6-7 is valid). Single 7 can be played as 1-card meld. Draw from stock (discard pile restricted). Lay off on any meld. Go out by melding all but last card + discard. All-at-once meld = double score.

Seven Bridge is a rummy variant played in Japan in which sevens have a special role. It is also known as Mâ Jan Bridge or Seven Rummy. The name Mâ Jan refers to Mah Jong, but the game has no connection to Contract Bridge and is only distantly related to Mah Jong. The rules are credited to Kuromiya Kimihiko and Takerube Nobuaki.
52 cards. A low, K high. 7 each.
